beats.reason: Distrusted humanity in general. Deeply distrustful or contemptuous of humanity as a whole..

beats.decisive_clue: hostility crosses relationships rather than targeting women
beats.reason: Hostility crosses relationships rather than targeting women. Deeply distrustful or contemptuous of humanity as a whole..
